resources.string: Choose your own emoji or download a new style.
Preview a TTF emoji font from your device
Apps that use system emoji switch to this style when they restart. You can restart System UI and running apps after applying.
%1$s downloaded. Find it in On device.
Stock emoji will return after System UI and apps restart. Emoji copied into apps are restored and their font downloads are enabled again. Your saved downloads are kept.
Restart to use your selected emoji in running apps.

This restarts System UI and closes running apps so they load the selected emoji. Google Play services and persistent system apps keep running. If you choose Later, apps switch the next time they start.
Use your emoji in apps that keep their own fonts.
This replaces emoji fonts in apps such as Facebook and Messenger and clears their font caches. Affected apps may close. Google\'s font provider is disabled until you restore stock emoji.
